findings.evidence:
for order in orders {
    let lines = db.lines_of_order(order.id)?;
findings.recommendation: Fetch every order's lines in one query: collect the order ids, call the existing `db.lines_of_orders(&ids)` (`WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`, api/src/db.rs:31), group the lines by `order_id` (e.g. a HashMap of totals), then build the summaries in the order `orders_of_customer` returned them, so results and ordering stay unchanged. Today a customer with 100 orders costs 101 queries (1 + one per order) on every customer page view, a user-facing path the proposal marks as hot; with the batch it is 2 queries whatever the count.
findings.title: One order-lines query per order (N+1) on the customer page
